picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC researchers built a single deep-learning model (WorldParticle) that simulates wildly different physical phenomena—from sliding sand to folding proteins—with one unified approach, a potential step toward general-purpose scientific simulation.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's AI-guided 'plug and play' vaccine design achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in animal trials, outperforming conventional approaches and pointing toward faster-responding pandemic defenses.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford showed AI models can learn general predictive skills from purely self-generated synthetic data rather than real-world observation, a result with major implications for how future models are trained.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It

picks.editorial_note: An NIH-funded, Case Western-led multi-institutional team will combine satellite imagery, animal models, and AI to untangle how environmental exposures like air pollution contribute to Alzheimer's and dementia risk.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: TUM's new German Center for Future Mobility site in Munich, backed by up to €20 million in federal funding, will pilot AI-driven autonomous public transportation at scale—a significant government bet on real-world AI deployment.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: SMU's $4.2 million NIST award funds a Digital Twin Technology Lab pairing AI, robotics, and HPC to advance semiconductor manufacturing and train the workforce behind it—directly tied to national chip-manufacturing priorities.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, building toward a joint laboratory, signals deepening academic-industry integration in embodied AI and robotics—an increasingly strategic frontier for both research and commercialization.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize sovereign industrial AI—spanning physical AI, agentic AI, robotics, and cybersecurity—reflects Europe's push to translate public research into domestically-controlled industrial capability.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' with Fermilab building agentic tools that automate documentation, code review, and benchmarking for scientific ML, marks a concrete step in federal infrastructure for AI-accelerated science under the Genesis Mission.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: Reporting on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's reported ties to a figure linked to a suspected Chinese espionage case raises national-security questions that could shape scrutiny of the AI hardware supply chain at the center of the field.
picks.title: Nvidia CEO’s scandal raises questions about US national security
